h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mau

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mau

items.pText: Mau, in eastern Uttar Pradesh, is a weaving town where many schools are still building their first proper play area. Principals here usually ask us one question first: what should we buy if we can only buy a few things this year? FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,310 km away, and delivers it to eastern UP by road.

We answer that question with a plan for your ground, not a catalogue. Send us its size, the classes that will use it and some photos. We will suggest a starter set and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing, leaving room for pieces you may add later. Our team or a dealer in north India handles installation.

c: This set covers swinging, sliding and group play, and it fits on a modest ground. Eastern UP has hot summers, a humid monsoon and cold winters, and galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts handle all three. When your next budget comes in, a multi play system can go into space already marked on the layout.

items.q: What should a school in Mau buy first?
items.a: A swing set, a slide and a see-saw or merry-go-round, with rubber flooring under them. This covers the main types of play on a modest budget.
Yes. We mark space for future pieces on the first layout drawing, so new equipment can be installed without moving what you already have.
